title: Let the Shabad clear the double mind
summary: This meets the fog that keeps reopening what was already shown. The line says the Guru's word fills the heart with reverence and cleans the dirt of duality.
takeaway: Let the Shabad thin the double mind.
lifeApplication: Before you chase a second explanation, stay with the line already given. Let reverence hold the mind long enough for its split to start closing.
